observations: All seven metric primitives and more than twenty realistic entries remain visible in the production composition.
Normal, success, warning, danger, info, loading, empty, long-value and technical-detail states remain distinguishable without color-only meaning.
Light and dark evidence reflows without horizontal clipping at every required viewport and zoom cell.
CJK, Latin and RTL content retain readable hierarchy; technical details wrap within their owning data region.
Keyboard focus, touch-emulated disclosure activation, named actions, disabled actions and textual status are present in the accessibility-tree evidence.
No chart, trend, KPI calculation, badge pile, sparkline, decorative card stack or consumer-specific field order was introduced.
